law: Every implementation decision not fixed by the plan/D1 set is pinned HERE before any PnL exists; A7 prelaunch audits this file against the code; a divergence found after scored PnL is an incident, never a silent choice.

decisions.fold_force_flat_price: fold's LAST SESSION CLOSE on the adjusted series (consistent with the death-contract marking convention; no leak into the next fold's open)
decisions.fills_basis: adjusted opens computed as raw_open x (adj_close/raw_close) at the fill bar — keeps entries/exits on the same total-return basis as the frozen DV pair and adjusted-close marks
decisions.exit_law_order: next served bar AFTER the decision date at its OPEN if in-fold (covers t+1 and multi-session halts identically); only if the name never serves again in-fold: death contract final served close; unexitable => FailLoud
decisions.reversal_axis_score: score = -(5-session past return) so the descending rank_book longs the biggest 5-session losers (plan: past return ASC)
decisions.band_at_exit: DVmed60 evaluated at the last served bar before the exit fill; fallback DV_FLOOR (band C, most conservative) when no DV window exists
decisions.death_and_fold_exits_pay_cost: they are fills; cost once per fill applies (band at exit per above)
decisions.dollar_base: per-fold PnL in $ computed at AUM_ref = $1,000,000 base (no cross-fold compounding for $ figures); return%/MDD from a compounded equity curve where each hold compounds its weight x (exit/entry - 1) at fill dates
decisions.annual_split_marks: F3 annual split (2021 vs 2022) is a mark-to-market attribution at the 2021-12-31 close of still-open positions; no trade, no cost
decisions.eligibility_dv_window: DVmed60 requires >= 30 of the trailing 60 sessions present with DV>0; else ineligible at t
decisions.unbookable_flatten: on an unbookable date all open holds exit by the exit law (next-bar open) and the book stays flat until the next bookable date
decisions.matched_book_construction: for each anchor member at t: nearest eligible non-member by |log(DVmed60 ratio)| within the same realized-vol tercile (60-session, >=30 rets) and same price tier (adj in [1,5)/[5,20)/[20,100)/[100,inf)); fallback same vol tercile only; else skipped; >=10 picks required else the matched book is flat that date; EW min(1/N, cap) like the anchor; same exits/costs/clock
decisions.random_timing_twin: per calendar: per fold offset ~ UniformInt(0,20) sessions from fold start, step 21; SPY single-position round trips at t+1 adj-open with band-A; PCG64 seed 20260923, 200 calendars
decisions.stress_accounting: tier 2.0 multiplies the SUM of entry+exit band costs by 2.0 (both fills symmetric)
decisions.pf_zero_zero: profit factor gross_win==0 and gross_loss==0 -> reported None (undefined), never 0; inf when gross_loss==0 and gross_win>0; concentration with total net <=0 -> explicit not-computable note, no signed share (M-2: all FailLoud paths RAISE, never return)
decisions.concentration_when_total_negative: FailLoud (shares undefined when total net PnL <= 0 — reported verbatim as not-computable instead of a signed share)
decisions.warmup_dynamic: own-series index at t >= 252 served bars (253rd session law), evaluated per name per date
decisions.spy_benchmark: PER-FOLD BUY-AND-HOLD (H-2): one entry at the fold first anchor-grid fill (t+1 adj-open), one exit at fold-last close, band-A once per fill; NO grid round-tripping; exposure matching applied at evaluation: spy_excess_folds = book fold net return - mean_invested_weight x SPY fold return
decisions.annual_split_construction: F3 holds spanning 2021-12-31: linear time interpolation of gross PnL between entry/exit ISO dates at the mark; exit cost split half/half across years; mark-only, no trade
decisions.beta_construction: entry-weighted average of member betas; member beta = OLS slope of member adjusted returns on SPY adjusted returns over the 60 sessions ending at the entry decision (>=30 pairs, sxx>0 guarded class iv)
decisions.drop_one_construction: additive leave-one-out on per-hold net rows (exact): drop-one-ticker = min over tickers of (total - ticker net) > 0; drop-one-year likewise on the four calendar-year nets
decisions.gap_at_t_counter: names whose alive interval covers t but serve no bar at t are counted in names_skipped_no_bar_at_t (M-3); names outside their alive interval are not counted as skipped
decisions.trial_identity_fields: every record carries cycle_id, family_id, arm_id, arm_config_digest (sha256 of family+cost+impl contracts), cost_tier, fold_contract (M-1)
decisions.matched_book_wiring: simulate per_date carries book_codes; matched_book consumes them and is wired into scored records as matched_book_folds (H-3)
decisions.annual_split_fold_map: fold->year via explicit map {F1_2019:2019, F2_2020:2020}; F3 split at the 2021-12-31 mark (H-6 KeyError fixed; T22 regression test)
decisions.matched_book_empty_fold: a fold with no matched rows reports None (flat), never crashes the scored run (M-5); anchor/neighbour/control cells keep the strict FailLoud (their empty fold = F8 violation)
decisions.stress_rows_shape: stress fold rows carry ONLY n_holds/gross/costs/net (L-4: no stale return_pct/expectancy)
decisions.trial_identity_full: records carry arm_config_digest + data_snapshot_digest (sha256 of crawl manifest + universe freeze) + code_freeze_sha (worktree HEAD at run time) (M-4)
decisions.concentration_wording: concentration reports not-computable (explicit note + total) when total net <= 0; signed shares are NEVER emitted in that case (L-6)
